note: Prototype contribution data. Until a persistent backend is added, submissions are stored in local demo data for iteration and review.

contributions.title: Example: prior authorization burden should stay measurable
contributions.body: Seed example. A useful contribution in this lane should not only claim that prior authorization creates waste. It should point to a measurable workflow burden, like repeated resubmission, clinician time lost, or delayed care episodes, so the room can compare claims against a visible cost surface.

review.decisionReason: Kept as a seed example because it demonstrates the level of specificity the room needs from evidence submissions.
review.reviewerNote: Translate this pattern into real evidence requirements once live contributors arrive.

contributions.title: Example: simplification may shift burden rather than remove it
contributions.body: Seed example. A serious objection is that claims simplification can look efficient at the payer layer while quietly shifting work onto clinics, especially smaller or rural providers with weaker staffing and IT support. The room should preserve this as a live objection unless a transition design answers it directly.
